entities.name: Kazuo Kubokawa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kazuo Kubokawa  was a Japanese astronomer, who, together with astronomer Okuro Oikawa, co-discovered the Mars-crosser asteroid 1139 Atami in 1929.
